Interface LogRouter.Router.Filter

Enclosing interface:
LogRouter.Router
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface LogRouter.Router.Filter
Drops or changes a route's events before its router gets them, for example to remove noisy events, change their level or mask their message with LogEvent.rewrite(LogEvent, LogEvent.Rewriter). Filters are selected by name with the "logging.route.{name}.filters" property: 
logging.route.default.filters=quietHealthChecks,maskCards

They run in the order listed, each on the event the previous one returned, after filters added with LogRouter.Router.Builder.filter(Filter). A filter is only given events whose level the route enables, so it cannot make a disabled event appear. When a filter returns an event at a level the route does not enable for the event's logger, the route drops it and later filters do not see it.

A filter changes only what its route sees. Other routes get the original event.

Filters must be thread-safe. One instance filters every event of its route, possibly from several threads at once. Events may already be frozen, for example when another route uses an async publisher. LogEvent.message() is the unformatted message in either case.

Filters are registered by name with register(ServiceRegistry, String, Provider). A name that is not registered fails when the route is built, with an error listing the registered names. A filter's own properties start with "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.", where filter is the name it is selected with. These standard filters are registered when the LogConfig is created:

  • throttle: limits how many events are kept per second, see ThrottleFilterBuilder.
  • dedupe: drops repeats of the same message, see DedupeFilterBuilder.
  • remap: moves events from one level to another, see RemapFilterBuilder.

    • filterOrNull

      @Nullable LogEvent filterOrNull(LogEvent event)
      Filters an event.
      Parameters:
      event - event the route enables, or the event the previous filter returned.
      Returns:
      the event to pass on, which may be the given event or a different one such as LogEvent.withLevel(LogEvent, Level) returns, or null to drop it.

    • register

      static void register(ServiceRegistry registry, String name, LogRouter.Router.Filter.Provider provider)
      Registers a filter under a name so routes can select it with "logging.route.{name}.filters", usually from a RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator. A name that is already registered is not replaced.
      Parameters:
      registry - usually LogConfig.serviceRegistry().
      name - the name used in the property.
      provider - creates the filter, given the route's name and config.
